description.zh: 一定温度下一定量的水能溶解的某物质有上限（溶解度）；饱和时溶解与结晶仍在进行且速率相等（动态平衡）；降温或蒸发可使多出的溶质结晶。仅为近似数据与一阶速率玩具模型。
description.en: At a given temperature a given amount of water can dissolve only so much of a substance (solubility); at saturation dissolving and crystallising continue at equal rates (dynamic equilibrium); cooling or evaporating crystallises the excess. Approximate data and a first-order toy rate model only.

reason.zh: 饱和溶液里固体仍在溶解、溶质仍在结晶，只是两个速率相等，所以宏观上量不再变化。
reason.en: In a saturated solution the solid still dissolves and solute still crystallises, but at equal rates, so the amounts stop changing on the large scale.

title.zh: 饱和是不是意味着溶解停止了？
title.en: Does saturation mean dissolving has stopped?
